title: Fair Tyrants
html_source:
The title of a book Bloom bought for his wife, mentioned in Chapter 10.

“Mr Bloom, alone, looked at the titles. FAIR TYRANTS by James Lovebirch. Know the kind that is. Had it? Yes.”
